description: Use this when the user has chosen a Servana business and asks you to contact it, request a quote, or ask about availability. It sends the user's enquiry to the business's Servana inbox; the business replies to the user directly. Before calling, show the user the exact message and get their approval, and include their name and an email or phone number. Do not use to confirm a booking or take payment (Servana does neither), or for businesses marked as not accepting AI-assistant messages.

message.description: The enquiry: what the user needs, when and where, plus the user's name and preferred contact (email or phone) so the business can reply

name: send_message_to_vendor
